content: Skedulo, a field service product rather than retail or hourly: qualification model is richer than most, combining certifications, licenses, skills, spoken languages, customer history, real-time location and travel time to build the pool of qualified workers for a job before assignment or dispatch. Shift tags match work to skill, qualification, and other worker attribute combinations. This is the most multi-dimensional qualification model found, reflecting field service having higher stakes per assignment than retail shift-filling.
